claim: If a program that opened a combiner blanking line is killed rather than closed, that line may stay open, with the fiber shutter also open. Unmeasured: this is an inference from two prior observations -- a blanking line kept its level after the task that wrote it was cleared (a blink that created and cleared a task per write still blinked), and the fiber shutter survives a kill -- and whether a line's level survives the writing process dying has not been tested.
validity_conditions: Ruled DOWNGRADE under 10.2.1: an assertion with no measurement of its own enters at E5 with a falsifier. FALSIFIER: kill the driving process with one line open, and see that line go dark by itself. Slot: O1 preflight and the orchestrator's abort path -- until falsified, a crashed controller is treated as possibly leaving a beam on. The microscope seat's version also said which barriers this repository's code can and cannot reach; that is code state and stays in the microscope's live checklist, not here. Rests on lunf_fiber_shutter_survives_a_controller_kill.
